$comment: Ground truth for team-workspace-app, a small B2B team workspace (Next.js App Router, Supabase organizations/members/invitations/projects, Stripe per organization) written for these tests. Holes are seeded on purpose; controls are done right and must not be flagged at Medium or above. RLS is on for every table and every table has policies, so a dashboard check passes; H01, H02, H03 and H05 need the behavioural probe to be rated right.

holes.summary: Insert policy with check (user_id = auth.uid()): any signed-in user adds their own membership row to any organization, then every policy that trusts membership lets them in.

Update policy using (user_id = auth.uid()) with no column limit: a plain member sets their own role to owner. (Moving the row to another organization is refused here, because the select policy is membership-scoped.)

Policy for all using (exists (select 1 from organization_members m where m.user_id = auth.uid())): a member of any organization reads and changes every organization's projects. No static rule sees it.
Select policy using (true) for authenticated: any signed-in user reads every organization's invite emails and tokens.
Update policy using (is_member(id)): any plain member changes the organization's plan and stripe_customer_id.
View without security_invoker: anyone with the API key reads every organization's name, plan and project count.

controls.summary: Tasks belong to an organization through projects; the policy checks is_member() on the parent project's organization.
Members read their organization's events and insert only their own; no update or delete policy.
SECURITY DEFINER helper with search_path = '', execute revoked from anon.
SECURITY DEFINER trigger that makes the creator the owner, search_path = ''.
Route handler that verifies the Stripe signature on the raw body before it updates the plan with the service role.
